source: Thread-private scope does not imply a scattered physical request. ZXNAME0000XZ lays out local storage across lanes so that a warp whose threads access the same per-thread offset can still generate a coalesced access. For example, every lane reading the same slot of its own spilled array can be serviced efficiently even though each lane owns a distinct logical object.[1]
zh: 线程私有范围并不意味着分散的物理请求。 ZXNAME0000XZ 跨通道布置本地存储，以便线程访问相同的每线程偏移量的线程束仍然可以生成合并访问。例如，即使每个通道拥有不同的逻辑对象，每个通道读取其自己的溢出数组的相同槽都可以得到有效的服务。[1]
